questions.question: What tech stack do you use?
questions.answer:
My go-to stack for 2025-2026:

**For portfolios/SaaS marketing:** Astro + Tailwind v4 + TypeScript + Nanostores + Vercel
**For SaaS apps:** Next.js 15 + shadcn + tRPC / Hono + Drizzle + PostgreSQL + Clerk
